method.hpsa_rows: Ohio, HPSA Status != Withdrawn, nonmissing HPSA Latitude/Longitude
method.distance: minimum haversine distance from each HPSA coordinate to a site with the same BHCMIS organization identifier

interpretation: The shared BHCMIS identifier is stronger than geographic proximity and supports an administrative organization-level crosswalk for 61 HPSA coordinate rows. It does not establish that a specific site is the designated service location, offers the designated primary-care service, accepts a patient, has an appointment, or produced completed care.
next_test: Use the shared identifier and site IDs to inspect service type, active hours, operating schedule, insurance/patient acceptance, appointment wait, and travel assumptions. Keep the 33 coordinate rows without a shared identifier and all non-coordinate population/geographic HPSA rows as explicit missingness.
storage_boundary: Retains compact counts and distance summaries only; the downloaded site CSV remains outside the repository.
